# .crate-names.txt
#
# The committed, hand-edited allow-list of crates.io package names this
# project already owns. scripts/check-crate-names.sh reads this file as the
# authoritative owned-name set and asserts it matches the workspace's
# publishable [package] names exactly, in both directions -- see ADR-0026.
#
# Add a line here ONLY after a human has confirmed the new crate's name is
# available on crates.io. This file is never auto-generated from the tree:
# deriving the expected set from the thing being checked would let the guard
# rubber-stamp whatever was just added, which defeats the point of the
# guard. Order does not matter -- this is a set, not a sequence.
paladin-ai
paladin-ai-core
paladin-ports
paladin-battalion
paladin-herald
paladin-llm
paladin-memory
paladin-storage
paladin-notifications
paladin-content
paladin-web
paladin-eval
